method: Static reverse engineering with Rizin, PE parsing, x86 disassembly, and independent RC4 settings decryption. Samples were not executed. Sandbox scores and ML predictions were not used as behavioral proof.

evidence: main at VA 0x41426b calls 0x414e65. Resource loader 0x41fa84 reads RCDATA SETTINGS. First byte gives a 44-byte RC4 key; the remaining bytes decrypt into pipe/control-character delimited settings. KSA at 0x407ba2 uses 256 DWORD state entries; PRGA at 0x407c11 swaps entries, sums modulo 256 and XORs the buffer.
Decoded settings configure controller 15.235.65.221:4001, agent name NUEVAS4001, install name remcos.exe and log name logs.dat. These values are evidence only and are not detection gates.

0x4190c4 resolves controller addresses and registers callback 0x419dc8. Receive loop 0x40483a consumes data through recv wrapper 0x404796; framed-message processing 0x4048f8 calls its callback. Dispatcher at 0x419e46 selects tasks through a jump table; 0x41a609 invokes online-keylogger start 0x40cd00.

Keylogger worker 0x40c0b9 installs global WH_KEYBOARD_LL (13) with callback 0x40c0a5. Handler 0x40c16c copies the keyboard event, dispatches key-down/up, records named keys through 0x40d020 and ordinary text through 0x40d2ec, then calls CallNextHookEx. Recording workers support local logs and online capture.
0x408493 builds the CMSTPLUA elevation moniker and calls CoGetObject. Caller 0x408519 invokes interface vtable offset 0x24 (ShellExec), passing an executable path.

0x41c6f4 resolves native section APIs, creates a suspended child, maps replacement PE contents, updates PEB.ImageBaseAddress at saved EBX+8, writes the replacement entry to saved EAX, sets thread context and resumes the thread.
trait_changes: Recognize the imported stack-context hollowing alternative in the Remcos family composite while retaining transfer-status and family evidence.
Add neutral DWORD-state RC4 transform signature.
Relocate bare binary/source CMSTPLUA class references to micro-behaviors/os/com/elevate at notable severity; preserve the activation composite.

evidence: CRT entry 0x402674 invokes 0x401cb0. Mode at 0x404120 is 3, selecting Active Setup routine 0x401900 and cleanup routine 0x401390.

0x401900 builds a GUID-named executable path and HKLM Active Setup Installed Components subkey, writes StubPath with REG_EXPAND_SZ, reads its own executable with CRT file I/O, writes a patched copy, and launches it. The patch writes DWORD 4 at raw offset 0x6a0, clears 32 bytes at 0x3058 and copies a GUID to 0x3078. These hardcoded offsets do not match the dumped image layout: the dispatch mode remains 3 at raw 0x4120, so successful transition to mode 4 is not established.

0x401260 deletes/replaces HKLM SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters ServiceDLL with a StormServer.dll path. The installer also has a separate service-install branch. These alternate branches are present code, not a claim that every branch runs in mode 3.

Resource DLL/101 is extracted by 0x402460 and written through 0x4023c0. Injection routine 0x401150 selects iexplore.exe/notepad.exe/calc.exe, starts a child, allocates remote memory, writes the DLL path and passes resolved LoadLibraryA as CreateRemoteThread entry.
0x401390 obtains its own short path and COMSPEC, builds /c del with output discarded, creates a suspended shell process and resumes it.

Injection helper entry jumps from 0x40115e to 0x40f696, executes its relocated call through long push/pop and increment/decrement filler, then jumps back at 0x40fbd6 to 0x401163. The .htext section also contains long self-exchange and self-move filler.
samples.limitation: Embedded DLL/101 is the same 39936-byte damaged image as in eefb3697d877; only its first 0x1000 bytes contain nonzero data. Its code, imports and exports are zeroed. Do not claim a working DDoS payload or successful DLL loading from these bytes. The self-patcher also retains offsets for a different on-disk layout; persistence intent and code are present, but runtime success is not established.

evidence: Shares the installer, Active Setup self-copy, mode-4 resource drop/injection, LanmanServer hijack and shell cleanup code described for 3dfa58f86b9d.
Entry 0x402674 reaches installer 0x401cb0; mode 3 selects Active Setup self-copy and cleanup. Injection routine uses the original call to 0x4010c0 rather than the .htext junk trampoline.
samples.limitation: Embedded DLL/101 is largely zeroed; no working DDoS behavior is asserted. The outer loader retains concrete persistence and injection code despite the damaged embedded payload. The same stale hardcoded self-patch offsets do not update the current image mode; no successful mode-4 transition is asserted.

verification.focused_controls: check.py: RC4 transform, permutation without XOR, non-code bytes, bare binary/source class identifiers, and combined claims; each new capability remains notable.
verification.regressions: ../encrypted-stager-remcos-review/check.py: six existing controls including Remcos banners and injection APIs without loader code remain non-hostile for the Remcos identity.
